questions.prompt: What outcome do you want to achieve?
Are you a solo founder, small team, agency, or another organisation?
What stage are you at: idea, validation, MVP, growth, maintenance, or operations?
What help do you need: product discovery, MVP definition, architecture, implementation, testing, or operations?
Do you need Hermes to inspect or change an existing project repository now?
Which integrations are needed now, if any?
Will the work involve sensitive data or credentials?
How much autonomy should Hermes have: draft-only, approval-required, or limited automatic actions after acceptance?
Which actions must always require your approval?
How should Hermes report progress and escalate blockers?
